question: How should recitation and meditation be alternated at their conclusions?
premises: At the end of recitation one should meditate on Śiva.
At the end of meditation recitation resumes.
The two practices are linked in sequence.
inference: Recitation should conclude with meditation on Śiva, and meditation should conclude with renewed recitation.
plain_english: At the end of recitation one should meditate on Śiva, and at the end of meditation one should again recite.
